'''Farrfin Droidworks''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-manufacturing company. It was based on [[Farrfin]] and led by members of the [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It produced a large amount of [[Aggressor-series battle droid]]s, which specialized in melee combat, hoping that one day the droids will become widespread enough to challenge the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
